builds.title: Briarvex peat warden, druid 1
builds.difficulty: Estimated CR 6 with one nonassociated druid level. 8 racial HD + 1 druid HD + 4 LA would be ECL 13 if the DM makes an exception to the book’s PC guidance.
builds.speed: 30 ft. Improved woodland stride, including magically altered undergrowth.
traits: Neutral evil. Touch AC 9, flat-footed AC 19. BAB +6, grapple +17. Fortitude +12, Reflex +2, Will +7. Space and reach 10 ft.
Plant traits grant immunity to mind-affecting effects, poison, sleep, paralysis, polymorph, stunning and critical hits. DR 5/slashing. Fire deals half again as much damage.
Feats are Improved Natural Attack (spiked fist), Iron Will, Power Attack and Weapon Focus (spiked fist).
Druid 1. Nature sense is included in Knowledge (nature) and Survival. Wild empathy +1. The animal companion is away from this encounter.
actions: Spiked fist +13 melee (2d6+7 plus embedded thorn). A full attack makes two swings at +13. Damage counts as bludgeoning and piercing.
Thorn Burrow (Su), swift. Within 100 ft. and line of effect, deal 3d6 piercing damage to one target with an embedded thorn. The target can spend a standard action to pull out its thorns.

Entangle (Su), at will, standard, CL 8. Plants in a 60-ft.-radius area around Saltburr catch and hold creatures for 1 round (Reflex DC 18). Creatures that save still move at half speed in the area. Saltburr ignores its own entangle.

Prepared druid spells, CL 1: create water, guidance and resistance once each at level 0. Cure light wounds (touch, 1d8+1 hp) and obscuring mist once each at level 1. The mist lasts 1 minute and extends 20 ft. from Saltburr. Sight within 5 ft. gives 20% concealment, and farther targets have total concealment.
builds.tactics: Warn once, then use entangle in a planted area and fight from 10 ft. Use Thorn Burrow after a hit. Retreat through briars or drop obscuring mist if the party brings fire.

builds.title: Nagatha sluice sentinel, fighter 1
builds.difficulty: Estimated CR 5. ECL 11 from 8 racial HD + 1 fighter HD + 2 LA.
builds.speed: Land 10 ft., burrow 10 ft. Viper’s Speed on a double move or run.
traits: Chaotic evil. Touch AC 9, flat-footed AC 17. BAB +9, grapple +11. Fortitude +9, Reflex +5, Will +7.
Immune to gaze attacks, illusions and visual effects. Beyond 60 ft. White Silt relies on hearing.
Feats are Great Fortitude, Improved Natural Attack (claws), Skill Focus (Listen), Multiattack and Weapon Focus (claw).
actions: Claw +12 melee (1d8+2). Full attack is two claws at +12 and a bite +9 (1d4+1 plus poison).
Bite poison (Ex). Fortitude DC 17 or take 2d4 Wisdom damage. Save again after 1 minute against another 2d4 Wisdom damage.
Viper’s Speed (Ex). Two land moves in one turn can total 100 ft. A legal full-round run can cover 200 ft.
builds.tactics: Wait underground near the sluice and emerge when a target comes within blindsight. Commit to a full attack once in reach. Double-move after a retreating foe if the floor is clear.

builds.title: Corruptor of Fate gate broker, rogue 1
builds.difficulty: Estimated CR 6. ECL 12 from 7 racial HD + 1 rogue HD + 4 LA.
traits: Neutral evil. Touch AC 15, flat-footed AC 14. BAB +7, grapple +9. Fortitude +8, Reflex +12, Will +5. Spell resistance 15. Dodge (+1 dodge AC against one designated opponent), Improved Initiative and Weapon Finesse.
Immune to acid, energy drain, necromantic effects, negative energy and poison. Resistance to cold, electricity and fire 10. Outsider weapons count as evil-aligned.
Unluck (Su). An attacker subject to this mind-affecting necromantic effect rolls twice for attack and damage rolls against Pennytwist and uses the lower result of each pair.
Rogue 1 grants trapfinding and +1d6 sneak attack against a target denied its Dexterity bonus to AC or a flanked target. Ranged sneak attacks work within 30 ft.
actions: Masterwork short sword +13/+8 melee (1d6+2 piercing, 19–20/×2 plus curse) or composite shortbow +12/+7 ranged (1d6 piercing, ×3, 70-ft. increment, 20 arrows). Movement plus attack uses the first bonus only.

Bestow Curse (Su), at will, CL 8. Contact with Pennytwist or a weapon it wields can curse a living target (Will DC 17 negates). On each of its turns a cursed target has a 50% chance to take no action. The curse is permanent until removed, and it does not affect undead.

Corrupting Gaze (Su), 30 ft. Use the 3.5 gaze rules, including the option to select a target with a standard action. Fortitude DC 14 negates. On failure the target takes 1d6 damage and takes −1 to attacks, skill checks and saves for 1 minute.
builds.tactics: Watch the gate from cover. A fleeing intruder receives an offer before Pennytwist draws steel. In a fight use the gaze to complicate a rush, then curse the first melee attacker.

builds.title: Windblade shaft courier, Windrazor ranger 1
builds.difficulty: Estimated CR 2. ECL 5 from 2 racial HD + 1 ranger HD + 2 LA.
builds.senses: Darkvision 60 ft., keen senses. Listen +7, Spot +7.
builds.speed: Land 10 ft., climb 10 ft., fly 40 ft. (good).
traits: Chaotic evil. Touch AC 13, flat-footed AC 11. BAB +3, grapple +0. Fortitude +5, Reflex +7, Will +4.
Feats are Flyby Attack, Weapon Finesse, Track (ranger bonus), Improved Critical (claw) and Improved Critical (bite). Tallowwing can take 10 on Climb checks while threatened.
Favored enemy, humans. Add +2 to weapon damage and to Bluff, Listen, Sense Motive, Spot and Survival checks against humanoid (human) targets. Wild empathy −1.
actions: Claw +6 melee (1d4+1, 19–20/×2). Full attack is two claws at +6 and a bite +1 (1d6, 19–20/×2). If both claws hit one foe, add rend damage 2d4+2.

Fearsome Critical (Ex). On a confirmed critical hit, every creature within 10 ft. makes a Will DC 9 save or becomes shaken. The NPC uses a 1-round duration because the book gives no duration. It is a mind-affecting fear effect.
Flyby Attack. While flying, make one claw attack as a standard action during one flying move, continuing with any remaining movement after attacking.
builds.tactics: Fly past an intruder, clawing once and keeping out of reach. Use a full attack only if a foe is stuck below the messenger perch.

builds.title: Varag ford runner, fighter 1
builds.difficulty: Estimated CR 2. ECL 6 from 3 racial HD + 1 fighter HD + 2 LA.
builds.speed: 60 ft. using the adult monster entry. Run and Spring Attack.
traits: Chaotic neutral. Touch AC 12, flat-footed AC 16. BAB +3, grapple +6. Fortitude +4, Reflex +5, Will +1.
Feats are Improved Initiative, Weapon Focus (scimitar), Run, Spring Attack and fighter bonus Power Attack. Masterwork studded leather has no armor check penalty.
Rusk can take 10 on Move Silently even while rushed or threatened. Run can cover 300 ft. in a straight line on unobstructed ground in light armor.
actions: Masterwork scimitar +8 melee (1d6+3 slashing, 18–20/×2). A common Power Attack trade is +6 to hit for 1d6+5 damage.

Spring Attack. Move before and after one melee attack within the 60-ft. move allowance, moving at least 5 ft. on either side. The attacked target cannot make an attack of opportunity for the movement.
builds.tactics: Find tracks by scent and approach quietly. Use Spring Attack from the path’s narrow shoulder, then retreat along firm ground before the fight traps Rusk in melee.

concepts.name: Saltburr
concepts.role: A druid who guards a peat-cutters’ boundary.
concepts.motive: Protect the marked seedbeds from the cutters and learn who removed the boundary stakes.
concepts.hook: Saltburr recognizes the tool marks on a stolen post. Recover it and the druid will reopen a footpath through the peat.

concepts.name: White Silt
concepts.role: The abandoned sentinel of an old sluice.
concepts.motive: Win freedom from a spirit naga without giving up the familiar entrance where it feels safe.
concepts.hook: White Silt will explain how the sluice opens if the party locates a companion missing from its patrol.

concepts.name: Pennytwist
concepts.role: A planar mercenary who sells safe passage through a bronze gate.
concepts.motive: Recover one signed contract before its debtor can burn it.
concepts.hook: Pennytwist has the gate word and will trade it for a meeting with the missing debtor.

concepts.name: Tallowwing
concepts.role: A Windrazor ranger who carries messages between air shafts.
concepts.motive: Find which signal tower stopped sending messages before its Windscythe commander docks the courier’s pay.
concepts.hook: Tallowwing will mark the safe shaft and how to reach the messenger perch if the party checks the tower.

concepts.name: Rusk Reedstep
concepts.role: A Varag runner who leads lost supply crews to a ford.
concepts.motive: Collect enough paid work to leave the mercenary band before winter.
concepts.hook: A caravan claims Rusk led it astray. Rusk wants the party to find the false cairn and its maker.
